snippet.title: Plant Everywhere - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Paint your city with plants in Plant Everywhere, a cozy guerilla gardening game about transforming neglected urban spaces into gardens that everyone can enjoy.

Plant freely across the city, water your plants and cross-pollinate different species to discover new hybrids. Learn which plants thrive under different conditions and use their unique abilities to reach new areas as you gradually uncover more of the city and its story.

Meet local residents who join your mission, craft and upgrade your tools and reclaim spaces left behind by corporate neglect — one garden at a time.

Wishlist Plant Everywhere now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4023470/Plant_Everywhere/
